topics.title: Europe swelters through heatwave
topics.summary: Parts of Europe are enduring another severe heatwave, with the UK recording 38.1C and several countries watching wildfire risk, transport strain and public-health warnings.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who handles a heatwave by making practical plans, and who just becomes dramatic about finding the nearest fan?

topics.title: Australia backs smelter transition
topics.summary: Australia is preparing major public support for Rio Tinto's Tomago aluminium smelter, with plans to shift the large power user toward renewable electricity by 2033.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a factory town has to reinvent its power source, who gets excited about the engineering and who worries about the bill?

topics.title: UK closes more asylum hotels
topics.summary: The UK government says dozens of asylum hotels have closed this year, but questions remain about where people are moved and how communities share responsibilities fairly.
topics.discussionPrompt: How would the group decide what counts as fair when one neighborhood keeps getting asked to handle more than another?

topics.title: Solar eclipse wows skywatchers
topics.summary: After yesterday's rare eclipse across parts of the Northern Hemisphere, skywatchers are still sharing reactions while the Perseid meteor shower gives night-sky fans another reason to look up.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who would insist the eclipse changed their whole personality, and who would be quietly checking when the next sky event happens?
